scientific_integrity: Uniform homotopy statement about Alexander duals; additive integral homology only for original cut complexes. Finite verification is not offered as a substitute for the all-parameter matching induction.
scientific_limitations: No full homotopy type of original cut complexes, no equivariant decomposition, no claim of bibliographic exhaustiveness. Independent external validation not performed.
title: Mixed-dimensional sphere wedges for ordinary four-cut complexes of three-row rook graphs
